_meta.warning: Every factor in this file is an illustrative placeholder, not a scientifically validated emission factor. None has been sourced from a verified standard, government database, or peer-reviewed dataset. Do not use for reporting, compliance, or investment decisions. Each factor's own 'confidence' and 'source' fields restate this explicitly so the flag survives being read out of context.
_meta.schema_note: Every entry in 'factors' carries: name, value, unit, year, geography, boundary, scope, source, confidence, notes.

factors.name: Grid Electricity (India) - CO2 intensity
factors.source: DEMO_PLACEHOLDER - not drawn from CEA CO2 Baseline Database or any verified registry
factors.notes: Replace with the relevant year's CEA (Central Electricity Authority) CO2 Baseline Database grid emission factor before real use.

factors.name: Renewable Electricity (Solar/Wind PPA or captive) - CO2 intensity
factors.boundary: Location-based, generation only; residual lifecycle emissions only
factors.source: DEMO_PLACEHOLDER - not drawn from a verified lifecycle-assessment or registry source
factors.notes: Non-zero value is a placeholder for residual embodied/lifecycle emissions; actual factor depends on PPA structure, technology mix, and any REC/certificate treatment.

factors.name: Natural Gas - combustion CO2 intensity
factors.source: DEMO_PLACEHOLDER - order-of-magnitude figure, not from IPCC/GHG Protocol default factor tables
factors.notes: Replace with an IPCC 2006 Guidelines (or GHG Protocol) default combustion factor, or a site-measured value, before real use.

factors.name: Coal - combustion CO2 intensity
factors.source: DEMO_PLACEHOLDER - order-of-magnitude figure, not from IPCC/GHG Protocol default factor tables
factors.notes: Coal quality (grade, ash content, calorific value) materially changes the real factor; replace with a coal-grade-specific verified value.

factors.name: Metallurgical Coke - combustion CO2 intensity
factors.notes: Retained for BOF-route calculations; not one of the 4 primary energy-source entries in energy_sources.json.

factors.name: EAF - High Scrap Charge (>80%) - process CO2
factors.boundary: Gate-to-gate, direct process emissions only (excludes purchased-energy emissions counted elsewhere)
factors.notes: Process-only factor; electricity and fuel emissions for the same heat are calculated separately.

factors.name: EAF - Low Scrap Charge (<50%) - process CO2
factors.notes: Process-only factor; electricity and fuel emissions for the same heat are calculated separately.

factors.name: BOF - Integrated Route - process CO2
factors.notes: Process-only factor; electricity and fuel emissions for the same heat are calculated separately.

factors.name: Ferro-Chrome - embodied CO2 (cradle-to-gate)
factors.boundary: Cradle-to-gate, upstream production of the alloy
factors.notes: Real value strongly depends on ore source, smelting route (submerged arc furnace type), and electricity mix used by the ferro-alloy producer.

factors.name: Ferro-Nickel - embodied CO2 (cradle-to-gate)
factors.boundary: Cradle-to-gate, upstream production of the alloy
factors.notes: Nickel pig iron vs. class-1 nickel routes have very different real emission intensities; this is a single generic placeholder.

factors.name: Nickel Metal - embodied CO2 (cradle-to-gate)
factors.notes: Class-1 refined nickel; real value varies widely by production route (sulphide vs laterite, HPAL vs pyrometallurgical).

factors.name: Stainless Scrap - embodied CO2
factors.boundary: Cradle-to-gate, collection/processing of scrap (excludes original production burden)
factors.source: DEMO_PLACEHOLDER - illustrative gap used only to demonstrate scrap-vs-virgin direction of effect
factors.notes: Intended only to show that a higher scrap ratio should reduce embodied emissions relative to virgin-ore feed; not a defensible LCA figure.

factors.name: Virgin Raw Material (ore-based) - embodied CO2
factors.boundary: Cradle-to-gate, mining through primary metal/alloy production
factors.source: DEMO_PLACEHOLDER - illustrative gap used only to demonstrate scrap-vs-virgin direction of effect
factors.notes: Intended only to show direction of effect; not a defensible LCA figure.
